positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Linear Algebra AEW Facilitator
positions.description:
Served as Academic Excellence Workshop (AEW) Facilitator for MATH 2940 [Linear Algebra for Engineers]

• Facilitated weekly 2-hour workshops with 20 engineering students.
• Developed custom worksheet problems and delivered lectures on complex linear algebra topics, including matrix operations, linear independence, vector space, and diagonalization.
• Attended biweekly training from the Engineering Learning Initiatives to practice active-learning techniques.

positions.title: New Seekers Summit
positions.description:
• Participated in a two-day program to learn about the role of quantitative science in finance and explore related career paths through tech talks and seminars. 
• Networked with engineers at Two Sigma and students from more than 40 universities.

honors.title: CU Make-A-Thon
honors.description:
Rookie's Award (4th place out of 20+ teams):
"Hear What You See," a device that composes music by interpreting visual artworks captured by its camera
